:module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_s3_object.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons has an explicit depends_on on aws_s3_object.this, but that dependency is already established implicitly: the spark_history_server_helm_config input uses both aws_s3_bucket.this.id and aws_s3_object.this.key in its values heredoc. The explicit depends_on entry on aws_s3_object.this is therefore redundant (the other depends_on entries — the bucket ACL, public access block, and encryption configuration — are not implied and remain necessary).

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng lists aws_iam_role.managed_ng in its depends_on, but the resource already references aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn via node_role_arn, which creates the same implicit dependency. The explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.managed_ng is redundant (the depends_on entries for the instance profile and policy attachment are not implicit and remain necessary).

null_resource.update_trust_policy lists aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution in its depends_on, but the local-exec command heredoc interpolates ${aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id}, which already creates an implicit dependency on that role. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.update_trust_policy lists kubernetes_namespace.spark in its depends_on, but the local-exec command heredoc interpolates ${kubernetes_namespace.spark.id}, which already creates an implicit dependency on that namespace. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.
